styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, soft mist-green #EDF3EE for info and scene shots, deep garden green #1E8A55 for claim and CTA panels

styleLock.surfaceSystem: light warm wood sill #E8DFD2 and neutral matte board #EDF3EE
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; soft mist-green #EDF3EE serves as the info and scene background tone
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line leaf icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright bag placement, consistent 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh garden-nutrition ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, deep garden green #1E8A55, charcoal text #2B2B2B and one warm yellow accent #F2D22E, with soft mist-green #EDF3EE as the info and scene background tone; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line leaf icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with the bag standing upright and natural even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张粉末水溶肥详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字样、包装文字与全部原文案，产品一律以 {product} 占位，效果表述全部走 callout 槽位，不可验证的资质元素一律省略。品类判定：taxonomy 无农资/肥料类目，源文件夹名亦无标准品类信息，依库内先例取 家居日用/驱虫。leaf 与库内已有肥料套图（通用营养液、花卉盆栽喷施营养液、果蔬粮食复合肥营养液、颗粒缓释肥、腐熟有机肥）按剂型与功能区分：本套为磷系促花粉末速溶兑水型。源文件夹名称中的营销词未进入模版。信任镜改为细腻粉质与速溶过程的可见细节。
